acv.quote: Two hundred and ten K ACV.

data.reason: Won memberships only, and the front desks stay with Global. Greg, the controller, signed four days after Tobi showed recoverable failed renewals in their own data. The rep first credited Maya.

trigger.action: Aim our message at churn caused by failed cards, not cancellations.
trigger.why: Corelane split board-reported churn and found far more members lost to failed cards than expected.
trigger.quote: The second bucket was a lot bigger than anyone expected.

decider.action: Show the controller what failed payments cost, using the customer's own file.
decider.why: Maya chose us, but the contract sat with Greg for two weeks until he saw the data.
decider.quote: Maya chose us. Greg decided whether anybody got chosen.

competitor.action: Answer front-desk reader and exit-fee questions before the incumbent raises them.
competitor.why: Per Maya, Global Payments offered a front-desk terminal bundle, then questions turned to readers and exit fees.
competitor.quote: Greg asked about termination fees twice.

message.action: Lead with recovery shown on the customer's own failed renewals.
message.why: Tobi's review of their failed renewals got Greg talking, while the global slide got silence.
message.quote: Greg hadn't said a word in two meetings, and he asked for the spreadsheet.

proof.action: Build a live demo of our reader inside their studio software.
proof.why: Corelane wanted check-in and sales on one screen, and only saw a partner demo later.

words.action: Call failed-card churn 'members who never meant to leave.'
words.why: Maya used this phrase herself, while our phrase 'unified commerce' made her ask about readers.
words.quote: members who never meant to leave.
